captions_note: the panel sits above the head and the reel's captions stay on over the chest

buyer_folder.name: tiles
buyer_folder.what: optional: one image per tile, if the buyer wants their own pictures on the tiles (plain lettered tiles are the default)

in_a_reel: TILES are the things the speaker names, each deleted on its word; plain lettered tiles or the buyer's own images, never a real product's logo the buyer does not own
set MODE and COUNT in the reel's language
the buyer's style wins: set the STYLE block at the top of build.py to the reel's caption style before the first build (effects/INDEX.md, Restyling an effect's own words)
steps: edit TILES, WORD, MODE and COUNT in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1      # prints the panel size, the timing and the snapshot times
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
